thread:
evan: Heads-up: product approved a breaking-change in SDK v4.3 around structured output handling. New default: SDK will validate model outputs against declared JSON schemas and surface structured parsing errors instead of best-effort fallback.
evan: Impact: this makes downstream contracts stricter (good for product stability) but could break apps that relied on fuzzy parsing. We're giving a 90-day migration window. EOL for old behavior: 2026-08-20.
nina: Docs action: publish a "Structured Output + Migration" guide and a compatibility section showing how to opt into old behavior during migration. I'll own it. Draft ETA: 2026-05-08.
diego: Engineering summary: v4.3 will add a `strict_structured_output` flag on the Client (default: true). We will also provide `schemaFallback=true` as an opt-in shim for 90 days. The flag affects the JSON schema validator (Ajv-backed) and will return an explicit StructuredOutputError when validation fails.
lucy: DevRel note: we'll push example migrations, code snippets, and a short video demo. Also adding a compatibility snippet for common frameworks (Node/Python/Ruby).
release-bot: release published: redwood-sdk v4.3.0-rc1 (tag: v4.3.0-rc1). Changelog: structured-output validation, strict parsing, migration helpers. https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/4.3.0-rc1
ops-bot: docs staging updated: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/structured-output-migration (staging token required).
nina: Draft doc snippets (quick):
```
# old behavior (fuzzy parsing, default v4.2)
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(prompt, output_schema=None)
# resp.output might be a dict or partial string

# new strict behavior (v4.3 default)
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), strict_structured_output=True)
resp = client.generate(prompt, output_schema=OrderSchema)
# raises StructuredOutputError if validation fails

# temporary fallback
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), strict_structured_output=True, schemaFallback=True)
resp = client.generate(prompt, output_schema=OrderSchema)
# fallback will attempt best-effort parse and attach `resp._fallback_warnings`
```
nina: Docs will include a checklist: detect schema errors, add schemaFallback for short-term, fix prompt/template to match schema, add unit tests.
diego: Telemetry: we'll emit `structured_schema_valid=true/false` labels for validation results when customers opt-in to telemetry. No request bodies will be captured.
evans: Migration timeline: - v4.3.0-rc1: developer preview (today) - docs migration guide draft: 2026-05-08 - GA v4.3: 2026-05-22 - schemaFallback available for 90 days after GA - hard enforcement (no fallback) from 2026-08-20
lucy: CS/Support: please prepare KB for common validation errors: missing required fields, type mismatches, and array vs object shape mismatches. We'll provide example prompts that fix these.
nina: Public messaging draft: "SDK v4.3 tightens structured-output parsing to improve contract reliability. We are providing a temporary schemaFallback option and a migration guide to help teams update templates and tests. See the migration guide for details and timelines."
diego: Note: `schemaFallback` is not designed for long-term use — it may change behavior and is only intended to reduce immediate breakage during migrations. We'll call that out loudly.
evans: Action items: - Nina: publish migration guide + sample PRs by 2026-05-08 - Diego: finalize v4.3 GA build by 2026-05-22 - Lucy: record short migration screencast + samples by 2026-05-15 - Support: KB + canned replies by 2026-05-10
lucy: I'm also scheduling a 30-min office hours session the week after GA for hands-on help.
evan: Thanks all. We'll announce in #general and update the public SDK changelog once docs and KB are ready. If anyone has customer-facing phrasing suggestions, drop them here. :rocket:
